title: Little Red Riding Hood
moral: Always keep the promise you made to Mother.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md §3-4). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 voice_script_en.json 의 en 그대로, trim 은 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.set:<home|promise|path|wolf|flowers|spli: 장면 세트(scene(key, cx) / panel: 꽃밭·지름길 위아래 분할)

lines.text: 어느 날, 집에서 엄마가 빨간 모자에게 바구니를 건넸어요.
lines.en: One day at home, Mother handed Little Red Riding Hood a basket.
segs: One day at home, Mother handed Little Red Riding Hood a basket.

lines.text: 엄마가 빨간 모자에게 말했어요. "할머니가 아프시단다. 맛있는 걸 가져다 드리렴."
lines.en: Mother said to Little Red Riding Hood. Grandmother is sick. Bring her something yummy.
segs: Mother said to Little Red Riding Hood.
Grandmother is sick. Bring her something yummy.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 빵과 우유와 사과를 바구니에 차곡차곡 담았어요.
lines.en: Red Hood packed the bread, the milk, and the apple neatly into her basket, one, two, three.
segs: Red Hood packed the bread, the milk, and the apple neatly into her basket, one, two, three.

lines.text: 엄마가 빨간 모자를 머리에 씌워 주었어요. 빨간 모자가 한 번 빙글 돌았어요.
lines.en: Mother put the red hood on her head. Red Hood spun around once.
segs: Mother put the red hood on her head. Red Hood spun around once.

lines.text: 할머니 댁은 숲 건너 저쪽, 꼬불꼬불 숲길 끝에 있었지요.
lines.en: Grandmother's house was across the forest, at the end of a long, winding path.
segs: Grandmother's house was across the forest, at the end of a long, winding path.

lines.text: 집을 나서기 전, 엄마가 빨간 모자를 불렀어요.
lines.en: Before Little Red Riding Hood left home, Mother called to her.
segs: Before Little Red Riding Hood left home, Mother called to her.

lines.text: "길에서 벗어나면 안 돼. 모르는 사람과 이야기하지도 마."
lines.en: Don't leave the path. And don't talk to strangers.
segs: Don't leave the path. And don't talk to strangers.

lines.text: "네, 엄마! 약속해요."
lines.en: Yes, Mother! I promise.

lines.text: 엄마와 빨간 모자는 새끼손가락을 걸었어요.
lines.en: Mother and Red Hood hooked their little fingers together.
segs: Mother and Red Hood hooked their little fingers together.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 바구니를 달랑달랑 흔들며 집을 나섰어요.
lines.en: Red Hood set off, swinging her basket, swing, swing, as she went.
segs: Red Hood set off, swinging her basket, swing, swing, as she went.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 콧노래를 부르며 숲길을 걸어요.
lines.en: Red Hood hummed as she walked along the forest path.
segs: Red Hood hummed as she walked along the forest path.

lines.text: 새들은 짹짹, 다람쥐는 쪼르르! 숲은 참 평화로웠지요.
lines.en: The birds went tweet, tweet, and a squirrel scampered by, scurry, scurry! The forest was so peaceful.
segs: The birds went tweet, tweet, and a squirrel scampered by, scurry, scurry! The forest was so peaceful.

lines.text: 어, 나무 뒤에서 뭔가 보슬보슬한 게 살짝 보였어요. 꼬리였나 봐요!
lines.en: Oh, something fluffy peeked out from behind a tree. It must be a tail!
segs: Oh, something fluffy peeked out from behind a tree. It must be a tail!

lines.text: 나무 옆에서 늑대가 슬그머니 나왔어요. "빨간 모자 아가씨, 어디 가니?"
lines.en: The wolf slipped out from beside a tree. Little Red Riding Hood, where are you going?
segs: The wolf slipped out from beside a tree.
Little Red Riding Hood, where are you going?

lines.text: "할머니 댁에 가요." 빨간 모자가 대답했어요.
lines.en: I'm going to Grandmother's house. Red Hood answered.

lines.text: 늑대는 입맛을 쩝쩝 다시며 눈을 번뜩였어요.
lines.en: The wolf smacked his lips, smack, smack, and his eyes gleamed.
segs: The wolf smacked his lips, smack, smack, and his eyes gleamed.

lines.text: "꽃을 따 가면 할머니가 참 좋아하실 텐데~"
lines.en: Grandmother would love it if you picked some flowers~
segs: Grandmother would love it if you picked some flowers~

lines.text: "좋은 생각이에요!" 빨간 모자는 엄마와 한 약속을 깜빡하고 말았어요.
lines.en: What a good idea! Red Hood forgot her promise to Mother.
segs: Red Hood forgot her promise to Mother.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 숲길을 벗어나 꽃밭으로 들어갔어요.
lines.en: Little Red Riding Hood left the forest path and went into the flower patch.
segs: Little Red Riding Hood left the forest path and went into the flower patch.

lines.text: 꽃밭에는 빨간 꽃, 노란 꽃, 파란 꽃이 알록달록 가득했어요.
lines.en: The flower field was full of red flowers, yellow flowers, and blue flowers, all bright and colorful.
segs: The flower field was full of red flowers, yellow flowers, and blue flowers, all bright and colorful.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 꽃을 한 송이씩 하나하나 꺾어 모았어요.
lines.en: Red Hood picked the flowers one by one, snip, snip, snip.
segs: Red Hood picked the flowers one by one, snip, snip, snip.

lines.text: 나비가 팔랑팔랑, 벌이 윙윙 따라다녔지요.
lines.en: Butterflies fluttered, flit, flit, and bees buzzed, bzzz, all around her.
segs: Butterflies fluttered, flit, flit, and bees buzzed, bzzz, all around her.

lines.text: 꽃병마다 꽃다발이 활짝! 빨간 모자는 꽃을 따느라 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.
lines.en: Bouquets in every vase! Red Hood was so busy picking flowers, she lost track of time.
segs: Bouquets in every vase! Red Hood was so busy picking flowers, she lost track of time.

lines.text: 늑대는 빨간 모자보다 먼저 할머니 집에 가려 했어요.
lines.en: Wolf wanted to reach Grandmother’s house before Little Red Riding Hood.
segs: Wolf wanted to reach Grandmother’s house before Little Red Riding Hood.

lines.text: 위에서는 빨간 모자가 꽃을 따요. 아래에서는 늑대가 지름길로 달려가요!
lines.en: Up above, Red Hood picks flowers. Down below, the wolf runs along the shortcut!
segs: Up above, Red Hood picks flowers. Down below, the wolf runs along the shortcut!

lines.text: 늑대는 할머니 집 문 앞에 도착했어요.
lines.en: Wolf reached the door of Grandmother’s house.
segs: Wolf reached the door of Grandmother’s house.

lines.text: 똑똑똑… 문이 닫히고… 꿀꺽!
lines.en: Knock, knock, knock... the door closes... gulp!
segs: Knock, knock, knock... the door closes... gulp!

lines.text: 집 안으로 들어간 늑대가 할머니를 삼켜 버렸어요.
lines.en: Wolf went inside and swallowed Grandmother.
segs: Wolf went inside and swallowed Grandmother.

lines.text: 늑대는 할머니의 잠옷을 입고 침대에 누웠어요.
lines.en: The wolf put on Grandmother's nightgown and lay down in her bed.
segs: The wolf put on Grandmother's nightgown and lay down in her bed.

lines.text: "흐흐, 이제 빨간 모자만 기다리면 되겠군." 늑대는 이불을 코까지 끌어올렸어요.
lines.en: "Heh heh, now I just have to wait for Red Hood." The wolf pulled the blanket right up to his nose.
segs: Heh heh, now I just have to wait for Red Hood.
The wolf pulled the blanket right up to his nose.

lines.text: 꽃을 다 딴 빨간 모자는 다시 숲길을 걸어갔어요.
lines.en: After picking flowers, Little Red Riding Hood walked along the forest path again.
segs: After picking flowers, Little Red Riding Hood walked along the forest path again.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 숲속 할머니 집에 도착해 문을 똑똑똑 두드렸어요.
lines.en: Red Hood reached Grandmother's house in the forest and knocked on the door, knock, knock, knock.
segs: Red Hood reached Grandmother's house in the forest and knocked on the door, knock, knock, knock.

lines.text: "들어오렴~" 안에서 쉰 목소리가 들렸어요.
lines.en: Come in~ A hoarse voice came from inside.
segs: A hoarse voice came from inside.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 문을 열고 침대 곁으로 다가갔어요.
lines.en: Little Red Riding Hood opened the door and went over to the bed.
segs: Little Red Riding Hood opened the door and went over to the bed.

lines.text: "할머니, 오셨어요?" 그런데 침대 속 할머니가 어딘가 이상해요.
lines.en: Grandmother, are you here? But Grandmother in the bed looked a little odd.
segs: But Grandmother in the bed looked a little odd.

lines.text: "할머니, 귀가 왜 이렇게 커요?"
lines.en: Grandmother, why are your ears so big?
segs: Grandmother, why are your ears so big?

lines.text: "네 말을 잘 들으려고 그렇지~"
lines.en: All the better to hear you with~
segs: All the better to hear you with~

lines.text: "할머니, 눈이 왜 이렇게 노랗고 커요?"
lines.en: Grandmother, why are your eyes so big and yellow?
segs: Grandmother, why are your eyes so big and yellow?

lines.text: "너를 잘 보려고 그렇지~"
lines.en: All the better to see you with~
segs: All the better to see you with~

lines.text: "할머니, 입이 왜 이렇게 길어요?"
lines.en: Grandmother, why is your mouth so long?
segs: Grandmother, why is your mouth so long?

lines.text: "그건 말이지… 어흥! 놀랐지?"
lines.en: Well, you see... Roar! Did I scare you?
segs: Well, you see... Roar! Did I scare you?

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 깜짝 놀랐어요. 이 사람은 할머니가 아니에요!
lines.en: Red Hood was startled. This is not Grandmother!
segs: Red Hood was startled. This is not Grandmother!

lines.text: 늑대가 벌떡 일어났어요!
lines.from: 늑대가 벌떡 일어났어요! 빨간 모자야, 어서 숨어요! 옷장을 톡!
lines.en: The wolf jumped up!

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 후다닥, 옷장 쪽으로 달려갔어요.
lines.en: Red Hood dashed, quick as a flash, over to the wardrobe.
segs: Red Hood dashed, quick as a flash, over to the wardrobe.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 옷장 속으로 쏙! 늑대는 두리번두리번 찾았지만 보이지 않았어요.
lines.en: Red Hood slipped into the wardrobe! The wolf looked all around but could not see her.
segs: Red Hood slipped into the wardrobe! The wolf looked all around but could not see her.

lines.text: 옷장 안은 깜깜했어요. 빨간 모자는 숨을 꼭 참고 가슴이 콩닥콩닥 뛰었지요.
lines.en: It was pitch dark inside the wardrobe. Red Hood held her breath, her heart going thump, thump, thump.
segs: It was pitch dark inside the wardrobe. Red Hood held her breath, her heart going thump, thump, thump.

lines.text: 할머니를 먹어서 배가 불렀던 늑대는 스르르 눈이 감겼어요. 쿨쿨…
lines.en: The wolf was full from eating Grandmother, and his eyes slowly closed. Zzz...
segs: The wolf was full from eating Grandmother, and his eyes slowly closed. Zzz...

lines.text: 창밖으로 지나가던 사냥꾼이 코 고는 소리를 들었어요.
lines.from: 창밖으로 지나가던 사냥꾼이 코 고는 소리를 들었어요. 창문을 톡톡 두드려 봐요!
lines.en: A hunter passing by the window heard the snoring.
segs: A hunter passing by the window heard the snoring.

lines.text: "이상한 코골이네? 할머니 댁에 무슨 일이 있나?" 사냥꾼이 방 안으로 들어왔어요.
lines.en: What a strange snore! Is something wrong at Grandmother's house? The hunter came into the room.
segs: What a strange snore! Is something wrong at Grandmother's house?
The hunter came into the room.

lines.text: "늑대잖아! 이럴 땐 간질간질 간지럼이 최고지!"
lines.en: It's a wolf! At a time like this, a tickle is the best!
segs: It's a wolf! At a time like this, a tickle is the best!

lines.text: 사냥꾼은 늑대 배를 간질간질, 옆구리를 살살 간지럽혔어요.
lines.en: The hunter tickled the wolf's tummy, tickle, tickle, and his sides, softly, softly.
segs: The hunter tickled the wolf's tummy, tickle, tickle, and his sides, softly, softly.

lines.text: 늑대가 딸꾹! 하자 할머니가 퐁! 하고 튀어나왔어요. 할머니는 다치지 않고 멀쩡했어요!
lines.en: The wolf hiccupped, hic! and Grandmother popped out, pop! Grandmother was not hurt at all!
segs: The wolf hiccupped, hic! and Grandmother popped out, pop! Grandmother was not hurt at all!

lines.text: 늑대는 깜짝 놀라서 "걸음아 날 살려라~" 하고 창밖으로 달아났어요.
lines.en: The wolf was so startled that Run for your life! and he ran away out the window.
segs: The wolf was so startled that
and he ran away out the window.

lines.text: 빨간 모자도 옷장에서 살그머니 나왔어요. "할머니!"
lines.en: Red Hood crept out of the wardrobe too. Grandma!
segs: Red Hood crept out of the wardrobe too.

lines.text: "아이고, 우리 강아지!" 할머니는 빨간 모자를 꼭 끌어안았어요.
lines.en: "Oh, my sweet little one!" Grandmother hugged Red Hood tight.

lines.text: 이제 안심한 세 사람은 침대 곁에서 식탁으로 자리를 옮겼어요.
lines.en: Safe at last, the three of them moved from the bedside to the table.
segs: Safe at last, the three of them moved from the bedside to the table.

lines.text: 할머니 집 식탁에서 모두 함께 차를 마셔요.
lines.from: 할머니 집 식탁에서 모두 함께 차를 마셔요. 바구니 속 간식을 한 가지씩 나눠 줘요!
lines.en: Everyone has tea together at Grandmother's table.
segs: Everyone has tea together at Grandmother's table.

lines.text: 빵은 할머니, 우유는 빨간 모자, 사과는 아저씨! 모두 냠냠 맛있게 먹었어요.
lines.en: Bread for Grandmother, milk for Red Hood, and the apple for Mr. Hunter! Everyone ate happily, yum, yum.
segs: Bread for Grandmother, milk for Red Hood, and the apple for Mr. Hunter! Everyone ate happily, yum, yum.

lines.text: "모두 고마워요!" 할머니는 활짝 웃었어요.
lines.en: Thank you, everyone! Grandmother smiled brightly.

lines.text: "엄마 말을 안 들어서 큰일 날 뻔했어요." 빨간 모자는 고개를 푹 숙였어요.
lines.en: "I didn't listen to Mother, and I almost got into big trouble." Red Hood hung her head low.
segs: I didn't listen to Mother, and I almost got into big trouble.
Red Hood hung her head low.

lines.text: "이제 약속을 꼭 지킬게요. 길에서 벗어나지 않고, 모르는 사람과는 이야기하지 않을래요."
lines.en: I'll keep my promise now. I won't leave the path, and I won't talk to strangers.
segs: I'll keep my promise now. I won't leave the path, and I won't talk to strangers.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 새끼손가락을 걸고, 오늘 일을 오래오래 기억했어요.
lines.en: Red Hood hooked her little finger again, and remembered today for a long, long time.
segs: Red Hood hooked her little finger again, and remembered today for a long, long time.

lines.text: 엄마와 한 약속은 꼭 지켜야 한답니다.
lines.en: A promise to Mother is a promise to keep.
segs: A promise to Mother is a promise to keep.
